plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Digi TransPort / Sarian cellular routers. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, device, processor and modem temperature, and interface traffic (SARIAN-MONITOR-MIB, enterprise PEN 16378). Digi Connect devices use the separate Digi template.
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Current CPU utilisation of the Digi TransPort / Sarian router in percent (SARIAN-MONITOR-MIB cpuUtil scalar).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Internal temperature of the Digi TransPort / Sarian router in degrees Celsius (SARIAN-MONITOR-MIB temperature scalar).

metrics.name: device_processor_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Processor temperature of the Digi TransPort / Sarian router in degrees Celsius (SARIAN-MONITOR-MIB processorTemperature scalar). Not reported by models without this sensor.

metrics.name: device_modem_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Cellular modem temperature of the Digi TransPort / Sarian router in degrees Celsius (SARIAN-MONITOR-MIB modemTemperature scalar). Not reported by models without a cellular module.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
